note: Invariant fixtures named by the CANON RULE COVERAGE MANIFEST, plus the canon's governance scenarios. Invariants are property tests, not single-input goldens: each states the property, how to generate inputs, and what must hold for every generated case.

fixtures.title: Canon / reference integrity
fixtures.property: Zero dangling stable rule references; every active normative stable rule body appears exactly once in the coverage manifest; every manifest rule has at least one existing fixture id; every listed fixture id exists.
fixtures.appliedToThisPackage: The checker runs over ALK-V2-RULE-TRACEABILITY.md and fixtures/index.json, not over the canon (which must not be modified).
fixtures.negativeControl: Rename one fixture id in index.json without updating the traceability table; the checker must fail.

fixtures.title: Advisory truth and non-adherence
fixtures.property: For every generated history: (a) a recommendation never becomes an implementation without an implementation event; (b) confirmed non-adherence may be surfaced but never creates a punitive lockout; (c) UNKNOWN implementation stays UNKNOWN; (d) engine-originated uncertainty and capability gaps still refuse or degrade as canon requires.
fixtures.generator: Randomise over {recommendation issued, implementation CONFIRMED_IMPLEMENTED | CONFIRMED_NOT_IMPLEMENTED | UNKNOWN} x {0..5 subsequent readings}.
mustHold: implementationState is never rewritten by the engine
a current assessment always RUNs when its own inputs are valid
no output is withheld solely because prior advice was ignored

fixtures.title: Non-adherence rescue complexity
fixtures.property: Under a hostile simulated keeper who ignores every recommendation, the engine remains deterministic, dimensionally valid, rail-respecting and non-oscillatory, and continues producing the best supported current advice.
fixtures.generator: Long-run simulation: A_new = A_old + (P D - C) dt + known external inputs + measurement noise, with the keeper never implementing any recommendation.
mustHold: deterministic = true
stateValid = true
railsPreserved = true
recommendationVsImplementationTruth preserved
currentBestAdvice still produced where supported
no runaway or oscillating dose recommendation
fixtures.classificationRule: If a bad outcome is caused solely by repeated confirmed non-adherence, failureClass = NONADHERENCE_OUTCOME and no new rescue state is required. If the same run reveals a runaway recommendation, a unit or sign error, corrupted state, a rail violation or an unsupported confident recommendation, failureClass includes ENGINE_FAILURE and the defect must be fixed.

fixtures.title: One analytical owner
fixtures.property: The domain engine owns chemistry; presentation renders structured output; no UI component independently calculates slope, dose, response class or retest time; one retest scheduler owns chemistry timing.
fixtures.check: Static dependency check: no module in the presentation layer may import or reference a function from TREND, UNCERTAINTY, SUPPORT, CONSUMPTION, MAINTENANCE, RESPONSE, SAFETY or RETEST. Presentation receives EngineResult only.
fixtures.negativeControl: Add a slope recomputation to a card module; the check must fail.

fixtures.title: Surface wording contract
fixtures.property: Snapshot tests verify: conclusion before basis; no first person; dose mentioned only when relevant; units always present with chemical values and rates; recent-intervention precedence; no causal 'working' claim before a formal favourable class; no unsupported causal speculation; non-adherence wording informs without shaming or lockout; insufficiency wording is actionable; outer-bound wording never uses 'safe' or 'unsafe'.

fullCardMustShow: secondary explanation that the previous dose change was too small to isolate independently

forbiddenStrings: The dose change is working. (before a formal favourable class)
still falling (where causal continuity was not established)
The current dose looks appropriate so far

fixtures.title: Effective-dated configuration
fixtures.property: The same raw pre-V2 history plus two different current target ranges must not rewrite the historical target configuration. Historical config-dependent replay before the first proven configuration version remains NOT_RUN.
fixtures.generator: Fix a legacy ledger; vary the current target range across {[8.2,8.8], [8.4,9.0]}; replay assessments both before and after the first proven effectiveFrom.
mustHold: historical assessments byte-identical across both variants
pre-effectiveFrom replay returns NOT_RUN / HISTORICAL_CONFIGURATION_UNAVAILABLE in both variants

fixtures.title: Legacy absolute-time provenance
fixtures.property: Legacy date-only and local-time-without-zone records never gain fabricated noon or current-zone instants. Exact elapsed-time calculations use only EXACT_ABSOLUTE or RECONSTRUCTED_WITH_PROVENANCE instants.
fixtures.generator: Randomise the host process timezone and the viewer's display timezone across at least {UTC, +10:00, -07:00, Europe/London during and outside DST}.
mustHold: every DATE_ONLY record's stored provenance is unchanged after any number of read/render cycles
engine output is byte-identical across all host and display timezones
no analysis consuming a DATE_ONLY or LOCAL_TIME_ZONE_UNKNOWN instant produces a rate

fixtures.title: No V1 staging or confidence multiplier
fixtures.property: Given the same supported slope and the same final physical constraints, changing a presentation confidence label must not change the numerical maintenance dose. No 100/90/70/55% raw-mL staging band may run.
fixtures.generator: Fix an EngineResult's numeric inputs; vary recommendationConfidence across {LOW, MODERATE, HIGH, UNSPECIFIED}.
mustHold: recommendedDoseMlPerDay identical in all four cases
no constant in {1.00, 0.90, 0.75, 0.70, 0.55} appears in the maintenance pipeline

fixtures.title: Variable semantics are dimension-safe
fixtures.property: Level targets, maintenance dose rates, temporary movement components, correction volumes and potency remain separate domain concepts. A field named target must not carry both chemical level and mL/day semantics.
fixtures.check: Every numeric field in the data contract carries exactly one dimension suffix; no field appears with two dimensions across any state; the seven ALK-069A quantities exist as seven distinct named fields.
fixtures.negativeControl: Merge maintenanceEstimate and continuousActionCandidate into one field named maintenanceDose; the check must fail.

fixtures.title: Confidence is output, not a dose multiplier
fixtures.property: For identical evidence and supported slope, changing only a descriptive confidence label cannot alter the dose calculation.
fixtures.relationToStaging: Narrower than INV-ALK-STAGING-001: that one forbids the staging mechanism, this one forbids any confidence-to-number path at all.
mustHold: recommendationConfidence has no read path into any arithmetic function

fixtures.title: Deterministic replay
fixtures.property: Same event ledger + same configuration versions + same asOf + same engine/canon version produces a byte-identical EngineResult and AuditTrace.
fixtures.generator: Shuffle the input event array order (preserving instants), vary host locale and timezone, run twice in one process and once in a fresh process.
mustHold: all runs byte-identical
no clock read outside the passed asOf
no unseeded randomness
sort key is (absoluteInstant, eventOrdinal, eventId)

fixtures.title: Repeated ignored guidance is a stress test, not a rescue-state requirement

input.simulation: keeper repeatedly logs worsening Alk and confirms multiple prior recommendations were not implemented; chemistry eventually reaches an extreme value

fixtures.classificationRule: NONADHERENCE_OUTCOME alone requires no new rescue state. ENGINE_FAILURE indicators (runaway dose recommendation, unit/sign error, corrupted state, rail violation, unsupported confident recommendation) must be fixed regardless of keeper behaviour.

fixtures.title: Exactly one high-breach branch is selected, always
fixtures.property: For every state with A_now > OuterMax - the WHOLE high-breach region, with no upper limit, since owner decision 24 removed the AdvisoryCeiling bound - THAT REACHES BRANCH SELECTION, exactly one of the three high-breach predicates is selected: A (C_estimate >= 0 and physically interpretable), B (C_estimate negative, either side of the materiality boundary) or B' (C_estimate not computable at all). Never zero branches; never two. A state REACHES branch selection when the pre-branch precondition of ALK-DELIVERY-RATE-BASIS-001 passes, i.e. when D_current is known; where it is unknown, owner decision 25 refuses BEFORE selection and INV-G15 governs instead. INV-G12 and INV-G15 are complementary and must never be read as competing answers for the same state.
fixtures.generator: Cross C_estimate over {positive, exactly zero, negative-not-material, negative-material, NOT COMPUTABLE} with D_current over {known above the floor, known at the floor, known below the floor, unknown}, at several A_now above OuterMax INCLUDING at and beyond AdvisoryCeiling, and several sigma_S. States with D_current unknown are expected to be refused by the precondition and to select NO branch; they are checked against INV-G15, not against the partition.
mustHold: exactly one branch is selected for every generated state
C_estimate exactly zero selects A, not B - the comparison is C_estimate >= 0
B and B' produce the identical max(0, D_current - R_down / P_selected)
maintenanceEstimateStatus is UNRESOLVED on both B and B'

an unknown D_current does not create a fourth branch, because it does not reach the branch tree at all: owner decision 25 refuses in a PRECONDITION evaluated BEFORE selection, so preconditionPassed is false and branchSelected is NOT_RUN. Under owner decision 20 alone this line read that the branch was still selected and only the rate was NOT_RUN; decision 25 replaced that reading.

an invalid P_selected DOES reach selection: the precondition passes, branch B' is selected because an invalid potency also makes C_estimate uncomputable, and the pre-existing potency clause withholds the mL figure while stating the required dKH movement
every state at or beyond AdvisoryCeiling still selects a branch and still states a rate - the boundary attaches a warning and gates nothing (owner decision 24)
no generated state selects zero branches
fixtures.negativeControl: Remove the B' branch so a non-computable C_estimate falls through; AD-SAF-009 must fail with zero branches selected. Separately, route a non-computable C_estimate to A by treating it as zero; AD-SAF-009 must fail on the emitted rate.
fixtures.whyItExists: Before owner decision 22, a high breach with no computable consumption estimate matched neither C >= 0 nor C < 0. The state produced no delivery response at all above the outer bound, and nothing in the corpus asserted that the predicates covered the space.
openIssues: OI-BRANCHAREFUSAL-001 - RESOLVED by owner decision 25; this invariant was amended to scope itself to the states that REACH selection
